verdict: Instagram furnace campaign is generating leads near category benchmark, but local reputation is the real engine right now.
diagnosis: Paid Instagram delivered 79 leads at roughly $146 each this period, while Google Business Profile drove 98 calls and 340 fresh five-star reviews.

signals.headline: 79 leads at $146 each
signals.detail: Instagram instant-form campaign spent $11,563 for 79 leads this period. Sits at the high end of the Meta HVAC range.

signals.headline: 340 new reviews, 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is compounding fast. This is the strongest signal in the data and the cheapest lead source you have.

signals.headline: 98 calls from Google profile
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 98 calls and 175 direction requests. Zero-cost demand that likely outpaces paid in close rate.

signals.headline: 274,575 impressions, 1,355 link clicks
signals.detail: Click-through on the Instagram ad is thin. Creative is reaching people but not pulling them to the form.

signals.headline: 17 Instagram followers added
signals.detail: Organic social is flat. Reach of 6,010 produced only 35 profile visits, signaling weak content pull-through.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Meta HVAC leads average $115 or more this year, with non-branded Google search near $149. Your $146 cost per lead is on the expensive side of Meta but still within the HVAC band.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: October kicks off peak heating demand. Cost per lead typically rises 2-3x through winter as every HVAC contractor bids on the same furnace searches. Expect pressure through February.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Local Services Ads average $51 per HVAC lead
competitor.body: Google Local Services Ads average $51 per HVAC lead with a 44% book rate. If you are not running them, competitors in Crestwood almost certainly are.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Category benchmarks show $51 per HVAC lead on Local Services Ads versus your $146 on Instagram. Worth a 30-day test given your 5-star review base.

recommendations.title: Rework Instant Form creative for furnace urgency
recommendations.detail: Consider testing two new video hooks focused on pre-winter tune-up pricing or breakdown risk. Current creative is reaching people but conversion to form is thin.

recommendations.title: Put your 340 new reviews to work
recommendations.detail: Review velocity is your strongest asset. Test featuring recent five-star quotes directly in ad creative and on the landing page to lift form conversion.
